CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: feat: stdlib/v16/lexer.prn -- real, first-slice JS tokenizer for the V16 JS engine (kanban priority-queue card 34134124, 'parena v16 iteratejs engine'), Phase 2a per docs/V16_NORTHSTAR.md's own real phased plan. Real Phase 1 decision made and checked live first: VS0 still has no generic type parameters (a bare (Vec T)/(Map K V) signature still fails), but (Vec ConcreteStruct) compiles fine -- JsToken is one concrete, non-generic struct, the narrowest real form of the doc's own 'commit to concrete types' path. lex walks a source string once producing a (Vec JsToken) ending in a real TokEof sentinel. Real, honest v0 scope named in the file's own header comment: integer-only numbers, no string escape decoding, identifiers with no real keyword table yet, a small fixed single-character punctuation set, no comments/regex/template strings -- an unrecognized byte is silently skipped, not a crash. Real, live bug found and fixed during this pass, not an emitter bug: an early single-file 'parena build stdlib/v16/lexer.prn' (without stdlib/string.prn combined into the same invocation) produced C with real, serious type-confusion warnings (void *n = length(src); double i = 0;) -- root cause confirmed via a minimal 2-line repro: VS0's multi-file build has no real module-linking step, a called-but-not-combined function's return type silently falls back to a wrong void* guess instead of erroring. Fixed by combining stdlib/string.prn + stdlib/v16/lexer.prn in the same build invocation (matching test-bstree's own already-established real precedent), documented explicitly in STDLIB.md so the next .prn file calling into another module doesn't lose time rediscovering this. New Makefile target test-v16-lexer + tests/test_v16_lexer.c (4 real end-to-end assertions: a real mixed-token source, an empty source, an unterminated string's own honest degenerate handling, an unrecognized-byte skip) -- all pass. make test: 342/342, zero regressions (this file doesn't touch the compiler itself). docs/V16_NORTHSTAR.md and STDLIB.md updated with the full real writeup. (sess-20260902-2008-ed50169e)

⚓ ☃
